second_order: opening and learning what r/place is
theme_note: These codes hold together as members opening the event topic, asking what it is, and explaining the shared canvas; what varies is whether the turn introduces, requests, or supplies the explanation.

second_order: proposing what and where to draw
theme_note: These proposals put forward a community mark or a place for it; the suggested designs and locations vary from rainworld, SBE, and never logos to a sad smiley and existing figures or flags.

second_order: scaling plans down to what a handful can make
theme_note: These turns test designs against limited people and time and reduce them; what varies is whether members call a design too much, count helpers, estimate duration, or accept a smaller face.

second_order: asking neighbouring groups for room and backing
theme_note: These turns approach or assess nearby canvas groups for approval, space, maintenance, or alliance; what varies is the group addressed and whether the turn asks, reports negotiation, identifies maintainers, or declares backing.
These replies directly accept or refuse requests to join the drawing; the response varies from volunteering to a late no.

second_order: carrying the attempt onto replacement canvases
theme_note: These turns move the unfinished drawing effort after r/place to pxls.space or plastuer.com/place and supply coordinates, Discord, or comparisons; what varies is the venue and the practical information supplied.

second_order: celebrating and joking about the wooden horse
theme_note: These turns claim, praise, name, and joke about the completed result as wooden horse; what varies is pride, laughter, mock mourning, praise, naming, and extending the joke.

These turns establish overlap terms, start and finish another smiley, and prioritise defending it; what varies is announcing the pact, beginning construction, instructing defense, and reporting completion.

These turns handle contact with the neighbouring comrades when drawings overlap; what varies is asking for protection, restating reciprocal terms, proposing Discord ambassadors, rejecting accommodation, requesting the link, and calling the overlap an invasion.

second_order: calling out thin participation and asking again
theme_note: These turns say communication or staffing is weak and renew recruitment; what varies is blaming poor communication, counting one person, proposing another wooden horse, and making it conditional on helpers.
